segments.t: Guilt-ridden after Katya storms out, Chef Barinov swallows his pride and walks into the ruined dining room of Claude Monet. He begs Vika to ask German to take Katya back—and admits that he planted the cat himself—just as the furious dog owner refuses to pay a single ruble for the ruined banquet.
Привет, Вика, хочу попросить тебя о помощи.
Мою Катю сегодня уволили совершенно несправедливо.
Поговори с Германом, чтобы вернул её обратно.
Нет, Витя, ты просто не знаешь.
Катя в этой истории реально виновата.
Вика, это я подкинул сюда кошку!
Девушка, я больше не буду ждать!
Пожалуйста, подождите ещё пять минут.
Я не собираюсь платить за этот кошмар!
Вы испортили праздник моему любимому Тёме!
И ещё испачкали его красивый костюмчик!
И что теперь, я еле живу!
Let's step through Chef Barinov's confession and the clash with the angry guest.
Привет, Вика, хочу попросить тебя о помощи.

'Hello, Vika, I want to ask you for help.' Adding that he wants to ask the guest for help fills in the missing piece for the guest. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Мою Катю сегодня уволили совершенно несправедливо.
'They fired my Katya completely unfairly today.' Over the conversation and the pride, Barinov answers the guest without a second thought.
Поговори с Германом, чтобы вернул её обратно.
'Talk to German so that he takes her back.' Even though the guest should talk to German so that he takes her back, Barinov keeps a steady face in front of the guest.
Нет, Витя, ты просто не знаешь.

'No, Vitya, you simply do not know.' Pointing out that Barinov simply do not know gives Barinov a sobering reality check. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Катя в этой истории реально виновата.
'Katya is really guilty in this story.' Vika explains that Katya is really guilty in this story, keeping her voice calm and direct.
Вика, это я подкинул сюда кошку!
'Vika, it was I who planted the cat here!' Declaring that it was he who planted the cat here brings Barinov's temper right to the surface.
Девушка, я больше не буду ждать!

'Miss, I am not going to wait any longer!' Declaring that Barinov should miss he is not going to wait any longer brings the guest's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Пожалуйста, подождите ещё пять минут.
'Please, wait another five minutes.' With the work and pride in play, Vika keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Я не собираюсь платить за этот кошмар!
'I am not going to pay for this nightmare!' The guest declares that he is not going to pay for this nightmare as the tension in the room peaks.
Вы испортили праздник моему любимому Тёме!

'You ruined the party for my beloved Tyoma!' With the point and banquet at stake, the guest reacts without holding back. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
И ещё испачкали его красивый костюмчик!

'And you also stained his handsome little suit!' Around the point and moment, the guest makes his point loud and clear. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.

When the guest snaps at Vika about her stained dog costume, Vika breaks down crying in the middle of the dining room. Next, an unexpected bond forms between Vika and the wealthy guest. Until next time!
